title: IBM CockroachDB PostgreSQL for IBM VPC 26.2.0 through 26.2.3, 25.4.0 through 25.4.12, and 25.2.0 through 25.2.20 is…
description: IBM CockroachDB PostgreSQL for IBM VPC versions 26.2.0 through 26.2.3, 25.4.0 through 25.4.12, and 25.2.0 through 25.2.20 contain a vulnerability that allows privilege escalation via user-defined functions. This vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.1 and impacts confidentiality and integrity without affecting availability. No patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
